title: Customer Walkup: fast-track for enterprise model adds and temporary pins
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a lightweight, auditable 'Customer Walkup' fast-track lane for enterprise customers requesting urgent model additions, temporary version pinning, or deprecation exemptions. The lane must enable a 24-hour turnaround SLA for triage, an automated compatibility and shadow-eval checklist, and a time-limited pinning mechanism (default 14 days) that non-destructively pins a catalog entry while reducing operational risk. Scope includes product requirements, Console UX flows (fast intake modal + steward approval panel), API contract for single-click temporal pin, guardrails for automatic rollback, and telemetry to measure cost/quality/regression risk. This ticket represents the PM scope: requirements, acceptance criteria, design handoff, release checklist, and cross-team coordination for pilot with two enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Fast intake flow: console modal and short-form API endpoint that captures customer reason, example prompt set (<= 20), and desired pin duration
SLA: triage acknowledgement within 2 business hours and steward decision within 24 hours for walkup lanes
Automated pre-checks: format compatibility (tokenizer/seq-len), model artifact availability, and basic safety eval run (shadow-eval) within the lane
Temporal pin API: createPin(model_id, version, duration_days) that marks catalog entry as pinned and emits audit log and expiration timestamp
Expiration/renewal UX: Console shows pin expiration and one-click renewal request; after expiration the model automatically unpins unless renewed
Fallback policy: if shadow-eval fails critical checks, steward receives blocking flag and a safe-compatible fallback variant is suggested automatically
Telemetry: per-request cost delta, shadow-eval quality score, and customer-facing latency impact are recorded to the Console dashboard for the pilot
Pilot completed with two enterprise customers and documented runbook for operations team
decisions: Use time-limited pins (default 14 days) instead of indefinite manual pins to limit long-term maintenance burden
Run a lightweight automated shadow-eval using customer-provided prompt set; require pass threshold OR steward signoff for exceptions
Expose both a Console modal for fast-triage and an API for programmatic walkups — Console path is primary for early pilot
Require audit log + email notification to cust success and security on any walkup pin creation
Do not allow pinning of models that are marked 'deprecated' unless explicit exec-level approval is captured in intake form
tasks: PM: finalize intake form fields and default durations
Design: low-fidelity modal + steward panel mockups and error states
Eng: implement /pins API, expiration job, audit log entries, and shadow-eval pipeline integration
Eng: add Console surfaces for pin creation, expiration banner, and renewal CTA
Security/Legal: run fast security checklist for pilot (data access, KMS consent for example prompts)
Customer Success: recruit two pilot customers and draft support playbook
Telem/Analytics: add metrics to Console (pin counts, average pin duration, shadow-eval pass rate, cost delta)
